general.languageHint: Applies immediately — no page reload needed.
general.resetHint: Only resets theme and language — mounts and services are never touched.

media.cacheLimit: Limit {mb} MiB / drop after {days} idle days
media.cacheHint: Thumbnails are evicted least-recently-used first — by capacity ceiling or idle age; clearing only removes cache files, never originals
media.ffmpegPathHint: Point to the ffmpeg binary or its install folder (e.g. C:/tools/ffmpeg/bin). When empty, ASMODAY_FFMPEG_PATH is used first, then the system PATH is probed.
media.note: FFmpeg only grabs cinema posters and encodes WebP thumbnails — never for transcoding.
media.resetHint: Only resets cache thresholds and the FFmpeg path.
media.preheatHint: Renders the last year of photos up front, so the gallery hits the local cache instead of pulling every original from the network share.
media.preheatIdle: Not started. Use the button to fill in one pass; indexing also fills a batch automatically.

security.hint: Changing the password invalidates all existing sessions immediately
security.mismatch: The two passwords do not match
security.totpHint: Scan the generated secret with any authenticator (1Password, Aegis, Google Authenticator), then enter a 6-digit code to finish enabling.
security.totpScanHint: Scan the QR code above with your authenticator, or type the secret below if you cannot scan.
security.forgotBody: There is no "disable authentication" switch in the config. On the server terminal run
security.forgotBody2: to get a one-time password, then change it after signing in.
security.davHint: Copy the full URL above and connect with any WebDAV client. You can sign in with your admin account and its login password (full access), or with a token below (name as username, asm_-prefixed token as password — recommended: read-only, mount scoping and expiry). Read-only tokens can only browse and download.
security.tokenOnce: This token is shown only once — copy it now
security.recoveryHint: If you lose your authenticator, sign in with one of these codes. Each code works once — store them offline.
security.davNoMounts: No mounts yet, create one first
security.backupHint: Download a hot SQLite backup (accounts, tokens and settings included). To restore, stop the service and replace data/asmoday.db with it.
security.verifyPlaceholder: Enter your current password to continue
security.verifyHint: Downloading a database backup requires a one-time password check; valid for 15 minutes.
security.usernameHint: Renaming signs out every device (this browser is renewed automatically)

advanced.formHint: Saving the form rewrites the TOML (comments are lost)
advanced.sourceHint: Source mode writes the file verbatim and keeps comments
advanced.unsavedLeave: You have unsaved configuration changes. Leave anyway?
advanced.portHint: A port change takes effect after restarting the process.
advanced.baseUrlPlaceholder: Leave empty for the root path
advanced.trustProxy: Trust X-Forwarded-* / X-Real-IP from the reverse proxy
advanced.mountsHint: Leave the name empty to use the folder name; the same path cannot be mounted twice.
advanced.followSymlinksHint: When on, symlinks/junctions inside a mount can be browsed, previewed, uploaded into and renamed even if the target lives outside the mount. Absolute paths outside the mount are still rejected. When off, escaping links are treated as broken (cross-drive links stop working).
advanced.protected: Mounts and services are edited here or in source mode; Reset defaults only touches General and Media.
advanced.servicesHint: Each entry becomes a card on the dashboard and is proxied through /proxy/<id>/.
advanced.resetHint: Default resets only apply to the General and Media panels; mounts and services must be edited by hand.
advanced.mountReadonlyHint: Read-only mount: every write is rejected and change actions are hidden

safety.HOST_ALL_INTERFACES_NO_SSL: Listening on 0.0.0.0 without SSL: the service is exposed on all interfaces. If you plan to expose it to the internet, please use a reverse proxy like Caddy/Nginx with HTTPS.
safety.PROXY_TRUST_NO_TRUSTED_IPS: auth.proxy_trust.enabled is on but trusted_ips is empty: anyone could forge headers to impersonate an admin. It has been force-disabled.
safety.PROXY_HEADERS_NO_TRUSTED_IPS: server.proxy.trust_proxy_headers is on but trusted_ips is empty: all clients share the same proxy IP.
safety.PROXY_TRUST_SKIP_2FA: auth.proxy_trust.skip_2fa is enabled: 2FA is bypassed for SSO logins.
safety.SSL_DISABLED_WITH_HTTPS_BASE: server.ssl.enabled=false but base_url looks like an https URL: please verify your deployment.
safety.RESET_PASSWORD_ENV_PRESENT: ASMODAY_RESET_PASSWORD is set: it takes effect on every start. Remove it after resetting.

users.singleHint: A default install only needs one administrator: every capability is enabled and there are no permission bits or mount scopes to manage. Creating the first account switches to multi-user, where each account gets its own permission bits and visible mounts.
users.createHint: The initial password is shown once; the user must change it at first login
users.deleteConfirm: Delete account "{name}"? Favorites, play history and tokens will be removed; shares become invalid.
users.passwordReset: Password reset; the user must change it at next login
users.permAdminHint: Admins have every permission; permission bits and mount scope do not apply
